text: Memphis, Tennessee: carjacking offenses by clearance status, 2024.
Reported by the Memphis Police Department.

A crime counts as cleared if it was cleared by the date of the data file, whenever that happened; the FBI's yearly tables instead count the clearances reported during the year, for crimes from any year.
